name: Add `rowbly skills create`
description:
If I am working on my project where I have rowbly. I expect to be able to run the following commands:

- `rowbly skills create`: Boilerplates a new skill for the user
- `rowbly skills list`: List all skills created with `create`
- `rowbly skills`: Help page, lists above commands


### Create Flags

- `--harness`: Allows the options: `codex`, `claude`, `gemini`, `pi`, `cursor` and `generic`. Defaults to `generic`. This determines the placement of the skill, whether in a `.codex/skills` or `.claude/skills`, etc. Generic puts it in `.agents/skills`.


For harness support and placement, I have another project that can act as a great reference point: https://github.com/sgolovine/distributor. This is all about placing skills in their correct locations.

### Skill Boilerplate

The skill boilerplate should include the rowbly reference (skills/rowbly-reference.md) in a reference sub-folder and short paragraph at the top (no more than 160 characters) that tells the agent about rowbly and gives it a link to the reference file.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR open: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/99 (branch claude/row-18-skills-create, head bbf237e). Adds `rowbly skills` (help), `skills create [name] --harness generic|claude|codex|gemini|pi|cursor --description` and `skills list` (table or --json). The reference is read from the packaged skills/rowbly-reference.md when the command runs. Validation: typecheck pass, lint pass, test:unit 66/66, test:cli 20/20; checked by hand for all harnesses, error exits 2 and 4, and from dist and npm pack. Screenshots on the PR. Open choices: codex goes to .agents/skills (per distributor); `list` shows any skill that holds the Rowbly reference. Land before ROW-20; merges cleanly with ROW-16's claude/row-16-rowbly-md branch.
